verdict.rationale: React's source is public on GitHub (facebook/react). Community discussion confirms React was relicensed from BSD+Patents to the permissive MIT license, and users mention reading the React source directly. The older PATENTS-clause concerns predate that relicensing, so they do not contradict the current open license. Missing for 10: a first-party statement of the license (e.g. a LICENSE file or docs citation), and evidence of the current license terms beyond the community reports of the relicensing.
